name: Notification summary, grouping and cooldown
plain: The OS decides when and how alerts are bundled: iOS summary, Android groups and cooldown.
meaning: Controls how often a person is nudged. Apps can only hint (relevance score, group keys); the system may hold alerts for a daily digest or mute rapid ones.

android.api_surface: Notification.Builder.setGroup(), setGroupSummary(); no numeric relevance score
android.note: Android 15 and 16 added notification cooldown and auto grouping; thresholds not published

ios.prompt_ui: Notification Summary setting: choose apps and times
ios.note: Passive notifications queue for the summary; relevance-score 0 to 1 orders them

limits.headline: Can't decide alone when your alerts arrive; the system groups them and holds some back
limits.user_action: You pick apps and times in Notification Summary on iPhone, or use adaptive notifications on Android
can: Mark an alert as low priority so it joins your summary
Rank alerts from 0 to 1 so important ones come first
Let Android group many alerts into one bundle
cannot: Bypass your Notification Summary on iPhone
Stop Android from cooling down noisy alerts, which started in Android 15 and 16
Know the exact thresholds, since they are not published
Choose your summary times for you
limits.reach_label: The system decides what you see
limits.differs: iPhone has Notification Summary with times you choose. Android uses cooldown and automatic grouping.

story.what_it_is: The phone decides how alerts are bundled, held for a digest or toned down if they come too fast.

marketing.name: Scheduled Summary
marketing.pitch: Apple pitches Notification Summary as a way to get less urgent alerts in one tidy bundle at times you choose.

marketing.name: Notification grouping
marketing.pitch: Google describes how Android groups related alerts into one stack.

story.for_you: You see fewer, tidier alerts. Less urgent ones may wait for a morning or evening digest. If one app sends many alerts in a row, the phone may quiet it.
story.for_makers: Makers can only hint at importance. They cannot force a spot, so they tune relevance scores and group names, and some try to game them to stay on top.

use_cases.example: A group chat with 50 messages becomes one grouped alert instead of 50.
A news app has its non urgent stories placed in your evening summary.
A social app is toned down after sending many likes alerts in a minute.
A store tries to mark every sale as top importance, but the phone ranks it lower.
A game with many reminders finds they are bundled into a daily digest.
A growth team tests different relevance scores to see which alerts people notice.
A calendar app keeps its next meeting alert on top of lower importance alerts.

risks: Apps may try to game the ranking
story.android_note: Android 15 and 16 add cooldown and auto grouping. Thresholds are not published.
story.ios_note: iOS lets you choose apps and times for a daily summary.

history.change: Scheduled notification summary and relevance score
Notification cooldown reduces rapid alert bursts
